voided_child_rows.note: Voided patients still bring their own rows

relationship_types.fallback: UUID rows for Sibling (30), Parent|Child (31), Child|Parent (37)

dde.effect: AETC National id (3) and DDE person document ID (27) load as Old identification number (2)

concepts.scope: only concepts used in AETC obs (questions and coded answers)
concepts.base: MaHIS-core concepts; matched by uuid, else MaHIS name lookup
concepts.value_storage: MaHIS concept datatype decides. Datatype N/A (963 of 1,042 mapped concepts): copy the AETC value as-is. Datatype Coded (79, all lab tests): AETC coded stays coded; AETC text -> coded via value_map; AETC numeric lab results copied as-is.
concepts.unconverted_values: stay in value_text and are logged unless filled in concept_unmapped_values.csv

visits.visit_type: AETC 1 AETC -> MaHIS 1 AETC (only type used)
visits.voided: skip, except visits of voided patients

encounters.voided: skip, except encounters of voided patients

obs.order_id: via id_map when the order is already migrated by 08; obs loaded before 08 are linked by 09_link_obs_orders.py (545,123 obs reference an order)
obs.voided: skip, except obs of voided patients

orders.order_type: AETC 4 'Lab ' -> MaHIS 6 'Lab' (order_type.json); no order_type rows inserted
orders.null_start_date: fill from date_created and log (113 orders from 2024)
orders.dropped_columns: date_activated, urgency, order_number, order_action, care_setting and other AETC-only columns (empty/constant; order_number = accession_number where set)
orders.order_extension: migrated with its order; created_at/updated_at dropped
orders.lims_tables: lab_lims_order_mappings migrated (stops the MaHIS LIMS push worker re-pushing old orders); lims_acknowledgement_statuses not migrated
orders.voided: skip, except rows of voided patients

unknown_location.choice: AETC location 1 'Unknown' -> 1291 for encounters and obs (location.json clinical_overrides); visits and identifiers unchanged
unknown_location.reason: Locatable default scope hides rows with NULL location

lab_results_as_text.choice: The 26 AETC lab tests whose results AETC stored partly as numbers and partly as text (full blood count, plus urea, GGT, AST, ALT): every result goes to value_text; numbers are written as text (rule numeric_to_text), text is kept as it is
lab_results_as_text.reason: one consistent storage per test; the text results (NaN, ^ flagged values) cannot be converted

blood_gas_concepts.choice: 11 AETC blood-gas concepts mapped by id to the MaHIS concepts with the same names (value copied as text); AETC 12533 and 12534 (no name, 11 obs) stay unmapped
blood_gas_concepts.reason: the MaHIS names are stored with broken characters, so the name match missed them; Louis will fix the names
